items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You just happen to have more Alberts around. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, that's right.

ctx.x: And so I say I want a question, I want you to tell me something. Yes, no. I said, people have been asking me why I play Album System clarinet. I'm just guessing I tell them that, well when I started playing they wasn't making a BAM System clarinet. He said, how long you been playing? I told him, he said, well you mistaken. So he said, BAM clarinet was made way back in 1853. So he said, wait a while. So he goes in the factory and comes back with the clarinet, the first BAM clarinet was made. And I said, this is…
You just happen to have more Alberts around.
